title: What Is Kota Doria? The Lightweight Rajasthani Fabric Behind the Perfect Dupatta
excerpt: What Kota Doria fabric is, how it is woven in Rajasthan, why it makes the perfect lightweight dupatta, how to style it for haldi, mehndi and festive days, and how to care for it.
seo_title: What Is Kota Doria Fabric? Styling & Care Guide (2026)
seo_description: Kota Doria is a light handwoven check fabric from Rajasthan. Learn how it is made, why it is perfect for dupattas, how to style it and how to care for it.
body:
## Quick answer

**Kota Doria** is a light, airy handwoven fabric from Rajasthan, made in Kaithoon village near Kota. It has a tiny square check pattern called **khat**, and is woven from cotton or a cotton and silk blend. It is so light that it is perfect for **dupattas and summer outfits**, and it adds a soft festive shimmer without feeling heavy. Kota Doria has a **Geographical Indication (GI) tag**, which protects its origin.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz team, Jaipur. Every piece is stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

## What makes Kota Doria special?

| Feature | What it means for you |
|---|---|
| Square check weave (khat) | A see-through grid that looks delicate and elegant |
| Very lightweight | Comfortable for long functions and hot weather |
| Cotton or cotton-silk | Breathable, with a gentle sheen in the silk blend |
| Handwoven in Rajasthan | Every piece has small variations from the loom |
| GI tag | The name is protected for fabric woven in the Kota region |

## Why Kota Doria is perfect for dupattas

A heavy dupatta can feel like a burden at a wedding or puja. Kota Doria drapes softly, stays light on the shoulder and lets air through. It takes dye beautifully, so it comes in bright festive colours like **mustard, pink, green and indigo**, often finished with **patch work, gota or tassels**.

## How to style a Kota Doria dupatta

- **With a printed cotton Anarkali:** a solid Kota Doria dupatta in a matching shade balances a busy print. Our [mustard floral cotton Anarkali](/products/mustard-floral-print-cotton-anarkali-suit-set-kota-doria-dupatta/) pairs with a mustard Kota Doria dupatta with patch work.
- **For haldi and mehndi:** yellow and green Kota Doria looks fresh and festive. See our [haldi outfit ideas](/blog/haldi-outfit-ideas-for-guests/) and [mehndi outfit guide](/blog/what-to-wear-to-a-mehndi-as-a-guest/).
- **For office and day events:** pair a pastel Kota Doria dupatta with a straight kurta set.
- **Drape it:** on one shoulder, across both shoulders, or as a cape. See [7 ways to drape a dupatta](/blog/how-to-drape-a-dupatta-7-ways/).

## Kota Doria vs chanderi vs organza

| | Kota Doria | Chanderi | Organza |
|---|---|---|---|
| Origin | Kota, Rajasthan | Chanderi, Madhya Pradesh | Many regions |
| Weave | Square check (khat) | Fine, smooth sheer weave | Crisp, sheer, stiff |
| Feel | Light and airy | Soft with a light sheen | Crisp, holds shape |
| Best for | Dupattas, summer sets | Kurta sets, dupattas | Party dupattas, festive wear |

Read more in our [Chanderi fabric guide](/blog/what-is-chanderi-fabric-how-to-style-a-chanderi-kurta-set/).

## How to care for Kota Doria

- Dry clean for the first wash, or hand wash gently in cold water
- Wash dark colours separately; handwoven dyes can bleed at first
- Never wring; roll in a towel to remove water
- Dry in shade, and iron on low heat while slightly damp
- A light starch keeps the crisp look

## Frequently asked questions

**Is Kota Doria cotton or silk?**
It is woven from cotton, or from a blend of cotton and silk. The silk blend has a slight sheen; pure cotton is more matte and breathable.

**Is Kota Doria good for summer?**
Yes. Its open check weave makes it one of the lightest Indian fabrics, ideal for hot and humid weather.

**How can I tell real Kota Doria?**
Look for the small square check (khat) pattern made by the weave itself, not printed on top. Handwoven pieces also have small irregularities.

**Does Kota Doria shrink?**
It can shrink slightly in hot water. Wash it in cold water or dry clean it.
